messages.author: 0b6337aa5aa02c18
messages.subject: problems with "gpagen" function
parts:
Hi all,

I was using Geomorph for some time a few years ago and established a working routine that worked well. However, having returned to the program recently I now get an error when I try to use the 'gpagen' function: 

Error in nu || nv : invalid 'x' type in 'x || y'

the script is here:

# read in .ply data
step1<-read.ply("step1.ply")
step2<-read.ply("step2.ply")
step3<-read.ply("step3.ply")

# manually input landmark coordinates, using semi-sliding landmarks
buildtemplate(step1, fixed=22, surface.sliders=300)

# manually input landmarks for other surfaces
digitsurface(step2, fixed=22)
digitsurface(step3, fixed=22)

# create file consisting of landmark coordinates for each surface
filelist=c("step1.nts", "step2.nts", "step3.nts")
mydata<-readmulti.nts(filelist)

# apply gpagen
GPA<-gpagen(mydata, Proj=TRUE, ProcD=TRUE, surfaces=sliders)

Error in nu || nv : invalid 'x' type in 'x || y'

Any help or advice on where I'm going wrong would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks in advance,

Elis Newham

Stan (and all list),

As Dean said, a new version of readmulti.nts is available on the Develop branch of github, which should be able to read in and even combine all types of nts files, i.e. single-specimen output from the geomorph digitizing function (2D and 3D), as well as single- and multiple-specimen nts files in the older format of NTSYS (i.e. the one used by NTSYS and the tps- series of J. Rohlf). 

Please try it out and let us know if it works as it should. Your issue, Stan, is probably related to that. If it doesn´t get solved, please contact me offline so we can have a look at your data and short this out.

Cheers,
Antigoni

Stan, in case you don´t know what the github branches are, you need to install devtools package first, and then run this command:

devtools::install_github("geomorphR/geomorph", ref = "Develop", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Please see the "read me" section of the geomorph github page: https://github.com/geomorphR/geomorph

Antigoni

Dean

On Saturday, May 8, 2021 at 12:28:42 PM UTC-7 ant...@gmail.com wrote:
Stan (and all list),

As Dean said, a new version of readmulti.nts is available on the Develop branch of github, which should be able to read in and even combine all types of nts files, i.e. single-specimen output from the geomorph digitizing function (2D and 3D), as well as single- and multiple-specimen nts files in the older format of NTSYS (i.e. the one used by NTSYS and the tps- series of J. Rohlf). 

Please try it out and let us know if it works as it should. Your issue, Stan, is probably related to that. If it doesn´t get solved, please contact me offline so we can have a look at your data and short this out.

Cheers,
Antigoni

On Friday, April 16, 2021 at 3:09:06 AM UTC-7 ant...@gmail.com wrote:

Elis,

 

this is very difficult to diagnose without checking the data at hand, but I don´t see anything in your script specifying the object sliders that you then try to use in gpagen. Maybe that´s the issue? 

 

If not, please contact me offline and send me the nts files you are trying to use (step1, step2, step3) so I can have a look if you want.

On Fri, Apr 16, 2021 at 11:30 AM 'Elis Newham' via geomorph R package <geomorph-...@googlegroups.com> wrote:

Hi all,

 

I was using Geomorph for some time a few years ago and established a working routine that worked well. However, having returned to the program recently I now get an error when I try to use the 'gpagen' function: 

 

Error in nu || nv : invalid 'x' type in 'x || y'

 

the script is here:

 

# read in .ply data

step1<-read.ply("step1.ply")

step2<-read.ply("step2.ply")

step3<-read.ply("step3.ply")

 

# manually input landmark coordinates, using semi-sliding landmarks

buildtemplate(step1, fixed=22, surface.sliders=300)

 

# manually input landmarks for other surfaces

digitsurface(step2, fixed=22)

digitsurface(step3, fixed=22)

 

# create file consisting of landmark coordinates for each surface

filelist=c("step1.nts", "step2.nts", "step3.nts")

mydata<-readmulti.nts(filelist)

 

# apply gpagen

GPA<-gpagen(mydata, Proj=TRUE, ProcD=TRUE, surfaces=sliders)

 

Error in nu || nv : invalid 'x' type in 'x || y'

 

Any help or advice on where I'm going wrong would be greatly appreciated.

 

Thanks in advance,

 

Elis Newham
